# Test report

> **Not production capacity. These results describe one laptop, with the simulator in the same VM as ES and Redis, and with repeated users.**

**Machine**

- Host: Mac17,3, Apple M5, 10 CPUs, 16 GB, macOS 26.6.2
- Docker: 29.7.2 on linux/arm64, with 6 CPUs and 3.825 GiB, kernel 7.0.12-linuxkit
- Redis 8.2.11 with jemalloc-5.3.0; Go 1.27.3
- The simulator, ES, and Redis all ran in that one VM.

Labels: [measured] was read from a run on the machine below. [calculated] is arithmetic on measured values, with no run of its own. [assumption] was chosen, not measured. Marks are separate: no line joins two points, and no value is drawn between them.

## Ramp and saturation

1h buckets, batches of 500, 30 s per step, 1,000,000 users, 500 segments. Stopped by saturation. Highest sustained rate: 1,024,000 events per second [measured].

After the ramp: 500 of 500 segments in range, 0 out of range, and 0 failed, with the estimate from -2.04% to +2.40% of acknowledged users [measured].

Source: Raw report of cmd/uss -ramp at commit cfabc4f, summarized by keeping totals per step and dropping per-segment detail. An idle second ES and Redis also ran in the VM.

## Burst

1h buckets. A base of 204,800 events per second, 10x from 10 s for 5 s, in a 30 s run. The peak is 2,048,000 events per second, and 15,360,000 events were offered [measured].

After the burst: 500 of 500 segments in range, 0 out of range, and 0 failed, with the estimate from -1.69% to +1.85% of acknowledged users [measured].

Source: Raw report of cmd/uss -profile burst at commit cfabc4f, on the same Redis right after the ramp, summarized by dropping per-segment detail. An idle second ES and Redis also ran in the VM.

## 1h against 6h, with the four rules

The rule was fixed before measuring, and its limits are owner decisions and [assumption]. Each rule has its own scale, and the dashed mark is its limit.

500 segments, with 2000 uncached calls at each size. Source: Raw test log of docker compose run --rm bench, run before the dependency update and not repeated.

![6h and 1h against the four rules](report/rules.svg)

| Rule | Limit | 6h | 1h | Label | Holds |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Rule 1: worst undercount, decision scenario | 6h above 1% | 1.27% | 0.22% | measured | yes |
| Rule 2: uncached estimate p99 | 1h at most 20 ms | 1.40 ms | 6.80 ms | measured | yes |
| Rule 3: Redis memory, 500 dense segments | 1h at most 2.5 GB | 0.41 GB | 2.43 GB | measured | yes |
| Rule 4: recomputation share of Redis time | 1h at most 20% | 1.44% | 6.26% | calculated | yes |
